preprocessLambda.description:
The c3 Lambda implementation of the preprocess function. The signature of the lambda is expected
to match that of {@link #preprocess}.

postprocessLambda.description:
The c3 Lambda implementation of the postprocess function. The signature of the lambda is expected
to match that of {@link #postprocess}.

title:
Concrete implementation of {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Processor} for dynamic processors that can be defined through
{@link Lambda}s.
Example:
```py
def preprocess_foo(request):
 messages = request
 last_message = messages[-1]
 last_message['content'] = last_message['content'] + "foo"
 return messages[:-1] + [last_message]

lambda_preprocessor = c3.GenaiCore.Llm.Processor.Lambda(preprocessLambda=lambda_preprocess)
client = c3.GenaiCore.Llm.Completion.Client(
  model=c3.GenaiCore.Llm.AzureOpenAi.Model(processor=lambda_preprocessor),
)
resp = client.completion(
  messages=[{"content": "Hello world?", "role": "user"}],
)
name: GenaiCore.Llm.Processor.Lambda
